title: SHE BOOKED
THE FLIGHT
summary: Pixie, Theo's online girlfriend of 2 years, booked a flight to meet him in 100 days. Everything he told her about himself is a lie.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.say: This is Theo. For two years, he's been dating a girl named Pixie. They met in an online game. They've never seen each other's faces.

scenes.speaker: narrator

texts.text: 100 days. i finally get to meet you

scenes.say: This morning, she texted him. She booked a flight. One hundred days from now, she's coming to meet him.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.say: One problem. Theo told her he's a six foot two firefighter, with abs, who plays guitar, speaks French, and has his own apartment.

scenes.speaker: deb
scenes.say: Theo! Is that a GIRL? Is she real? Should I make a lasagna?

scenes.speaker: theo
scenes.say: Okay okay okay. A hundred days to make every lie true. I can't do this alone.

scenes.speaker: theo
scenes.say: Top comment picks what I fix tomorrow. Want to be in it? Tell me who you'd be.
